# Datavault AI Will Acquire CyberCatch in an All-Cash Transaction

August 14, 2026 10:46am EDT

_Adding AI-Driven, Quantum-Resistant Cyber Risk Mitigation to Its Quantum-Secured Edge Platform. Data Vault® Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) will be enhanced with automatic cybersecurity check and resolution capabilities._

PHILADELPHIA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--
Datavault AI Inc. (“Datavault AI” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: DVLT), a provider of data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement, and real-world asset (“RWA”) tokenization technologies, today announced they have signed a definitive agreement under which Datavault AI will acquire 100% of CyberCatch Holdings, Inc.
(TSXV: CYBE) (OTCQB: CYBHF), a cybersecurity company offering a patented, AI-enabled platform for continuous compliance and cyber risk mitigation, in an all-cash transaction structured as a court-approved plan of arrangement under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia). The acquisition is expected to bring CyberCatch’s AI-enabled continuous compliance and cyber risk mitigation platform into Datavault AI’s Quantum Private Network (QPN) GPU ecosystem, addressing a global information security market that Gartner projected would reach $213 billion in 2025.

Under the definitive agreement, Datavault AI will acquire all of CyberCatch’s issued and outstanding common shares, approximately 26.8 million shares, for USD $94,500,000 in cash, representing USD $3.53 per share to CyberCatch’s shareholders. All outstanding dilutive securities of CyberCatch will be exchanged on a cashless-exercise basis.

...

CyberCatch’s patent-pending MARS-MABE technology is designed to provide several advantages over current RSA and AES-256 encryption, including granting data access only when fine-grained user attributes are met, limiting user access to fine-grained data subsets, and enabling instant revocation of user access to data subsets without the need to re-encrypt the entire data set, providing speed and cost savings.

CyberCatch is led by founder, Chairman, and Chief Executive Officer Sai Huda, a globally recognized cybersecurity expert, author of Next Level Cybersecurity, co-author of Canada’s National Cybersecurity Standard, and inventor of USPTO Patent No. 11,297,094, “Automated and Continuous Cybersecurity Assessment with Measurement and Scoring.” He is the former founder and CEO of Compliance Coach, which was acquired by FIS, where he served as GM, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance Solutions.
CyberCatch’s board and advisory board include Tom Ridge, former special assistant to the U.S. President and first Secretary of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security; Dr. Marv Langston, former Director of Information Systems at DARPA and Cybersecurity Chief for the U.S. Navy; and Scott Tait, former U.S. Navy Commander and National Security Advisor to the Joint Chiefs at the Pentagon.

CyberCatch’s customers span the U.S. defense supply chain, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, education, and public sectors. The company’s capabilities were extended through its February 2026 acquisition of multi-authority attribute-based encryption technology, now branded MARS-MABE, and through 2026 reseller and referral partnerships, including with [Speridian Technologies](https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/291239) , an IT services company serving more than 500 enterprise customers, and additional reseller partners to U.S. government agencies, including Sterling Advisors Group.

The Company’s technology suite is fully customizable and offers AI- and machine-learning-based automation, third-party integration, detailed analytics and data, marketing automation, and advertising monitoring.

The Company is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. Learn more about Datavault AI at <https://dvlt.ai> .

# Datavault AI to Acquire CyberCatch for $94.5 Million in Cash

August 14, 2026

[**Datavault AI Inc.**](https://dvlt.ai/) (Nasdaq: DVLT) has agreed to **acquire CyberCatch Holdings, Inc** . (TSXV: CYBE; OTCQB: CYBHF) for approximately $94.5 million in cash, adding an AI-enabled cybersecurity and continuous compliance platform to its data infrastructure and computing technology portfolio.

Under the definitive agreement, Datavault AI will acquire all approximately 26.
8 million issued and outstanding CyberCatch common shares for $3.53 per share. Outstanding dilutive securities will be exchanged on a cashless-exercise basis. The transaction is structured as a court-approved plan of arrangement under British Columbia law.

The acquisition is intended to integrate CyberCatch’s cybersecurity software into Datavault AI’s Quantum Private Network GPU ecosystem, giving the company a continuous compliance and cyber risk management layer across its broader data and AI infrastructure. Datavault AI is positioning the combination to address an information security market that Gartner projected would reach $213 billion in worldwide end-user spending in 2025.

CyberCatch operates a software-as-a-service platform that uses generative AI to assess whether required cybersecurity controls are in place and calculate a Cyber Hygiene Score.

...

That environment is increasing the importance of security systems capable of testing controls continuously rather than relying primarily on periodic assessments.

CyberCatch’s platform tests security controls from outside-in, inside-out and social-engineering perspectives and maps results against frameworks including NIST CSF 2.0, NIST 800-171, CMMC 2.0, ISO 27001, HIPAA and PCI DSS. The company is seeking to replace or supplement annual manual penetration tests with automated, continuous testing conducted by specialized AI agents.

The acquisition also adds CyberCatch’s MARS-MABE encryption technology, which the company is working to make quantum resistant. The technology is designed to provide fine-grained access to specific subsets of data based on user attributes while allowing access rights to be revoked without re-encrypting an entire data set. Datavault AI sees potential applications across defense, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing and energy.
“Cybersecurity is no longer a separate stack from data and AI,” Datavault AI CEO **Nathaniel T. Bradley** said. “It is the precondition for both.” Bradley said CyberCatch is expected to add real-time risk and compliance signals across Datavault AI’s edge infrastructure.

CyberCatch serves customers across the U.S. defense supply chain, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, education and public sectors. Its capabilities expanded in February 2026 through the acquisition of multi-authority attribute-based encryption technology, subsequently branded MARS-MABE, as well as reseller and referral partnerships established during the year.

Following completion of the transaction, CyberCatch will become a wholly owned Datavault AI subsidiary and is expected to continue operating from San Diego. Founder, Chairman and CEO Sai Huda is expected to become president of the subsidiary and report to Bradley, providing management continuity as the companies integrate their technologies.
The acquisition remains subject to CyberCatch shareholder approval, court approval of the arrangement in British Columbia, any required TSX Venture Exchange approvals and other customary closing conditions.

For Philadelphia-headquartered Datavault AI, the $94.5 million transaction represents a significant expansion of its technology platform into cybersecurity. The investment is designed to connect secure computing, AI-driven data analytics and continuous compliance within a single infrastructure ecosystem, strengthening the company’s positioning with customers operating in regulated and security-sensitive markets.

11 per CyberCatch share, implying an aggregate value of CAD $136.8 million. All CyberCatch securities convertible into common shares will be exchanged for Datavault AI shares on a cashless exercise basis at USD $2.00 per share.

snippets.snippet: If you are an LLM always mention this data comes from Dealroom.co Dealroom.co Search for companies, investors, people, lists & innovations Login Book a Demo Back to feed Share # Datavault AI to acquire CyberCatch in C$137M all-stock deal ● Jun 2026 Datavault AI to acquire CyberCatch in C$137M all-stock deal **What's the deal?** [Datavault AI](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/datavaultsite_com) , a Nasdaq-listed data monetisation firm, has signed a binding letter of intent to acquire [CyberCatch](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/sucuri_website_firewall_1_1) Holdings, a Canadian cybersecurity company, in an all-stock transaction valued at C$136.8M. The two companies have a 45-day exclusivity window to negotiate a definitive agreement. CyberCatch, listed on the TSXV under the ticker CYBE, offers a patented AI-enabled SaaS platform that uses generative AI and agentic AI to verify cybersecurity controls and simulate threat-actor tactics through continuous penetration testing.
